g.text: y-axis = DINO-S (style purity), NOT Style Affinity — V15 was evaluated with DINO metrics only (no CLIP-S), so this is the largest common metric set across all series. V8/V11B ms/img = gen wall time incl. model+edit (750 tasks, batch 8, RTX 3060); V11B on RTX 4070. External times from paper.tex; H2S/SG reproduced on same 750 tasks (H2S ~5 img/s resident runner; SG official per-image subprocess 76.0 s). V15 Group A markers are fixed-size (throughput not instrumented): 16 arms x t0 {0.0,0.4,0.7}, cross600 means from runs/v15/eval/W_*.json. idt floor = Identity DINO-S 0.3633; tgt floor = 0.2190. WCT/SaMST dropped (DINO-C < 0.20).
